raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (the 2026-01-18 delivery) carries amounts with a '$' prefix, such as '$10.02', while earlier batches are plain numeric strings, so the DECIMAL cast fails. Stripping the currency symbol (and any thousands separators) before casting recovers the intended values, since all rows are USD and the amounts fall in the expected range.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(replace(trim(amount), '$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
